_comment: In JSON for the same reason as terminology-quote-boundary.fixtures.json:
the lines use words the gate rejects, and the gate does not scan .json.
`marker` is the file-level opt-in line (BUG-006259, Director 2026-10-09).
`exempt`  - official designation copy; silent ONLY when the file carries the marker.
`flagged` - non-designation copy; reported even when the file carries the marker.

flagged.name: learner word in the same marked file
